packet_dag.terminal_condition: Each REQ-20260710-037 through REQ-20260710-046 is Done, Already satisfied, Blocked, Needs operator decision, Failed, or Archived with evidence.

title: One Time public landing implementation packet

reasons: The prompt asks for a complete rebuild of the One Time public landing page with exact section order, visual system, signup behavior, assets, responsive testing, accessibility, and proof.
The prompt references broad product-quality language and many UI states, so Product Quality Compiler and screenshot evidence are required.
The executable implementation slice is one public marketing route plus its existing lead/onboarding support APIs; provider setup and final media decisions are split as blockers.
likely_external_provider_blockers: direct WhatsApp public number/readiness may be unavailable
public teaching-photo permissions and verified location captions required
Ramat Beit Shemesh address approval required

operator_intent_summary: Rebuild the actual OneTimeOneTime Mishnayos public landing page for Rabbi Eli Scheller into a premium black, white, luminous yellow, and restrained ice-blue public marketing experience. Every Sign Up Now control must open the same real quick-capture flow, the old yellow form and old competing calls to action must be removed, available real assets must be mapped, and local proof must be captured.
raw_quotes: This is not an audit, design recommendation, or mockup exercise.
Do not stop with a plan.
The only marketing CTA wording is: Sign Up Now.
Do not invent the final hero image. That will be supplied later.
Do not deploy unless deployment is explicitly authorized by the enclosing task.

decisions_captured.decision: Final hero image is not supplied; use an intentionally image-free hero treatment and keep a replacement slot.
Robot Scheller image was resolved from RAW-20260710-009 using the latest downloaded approved image and cropped for the launcher bubble.
Teaching photo permissions and location captions require operator/Rabbi confirmation before final public use.
Ramat Beit Shemesh address spelling and publication approval require confirmation.
Social icons require verified URLs; placeholders are forbidden.
Deployment is authorized by the enclosing owner-experience closure prompt and the operator's keep-going instruction for safe app-visible One Time fixes.

out_of_scope: No deployment outside the existing One Time Railway one-time-web production service.
No payment, checkout, access grant, Zoom write, Drive write, Vimeo upload, email send, WhatsApp send, WAPI mutation, DNS change, or external provider mutation.
No GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM runtime.
No fabricated logos, testimonials, statistics, affiliations, locations, social links, media appearances, or stock classroom photographs.
No raw private contact export, private student data, or private transcript body committed to GitHub.

known_current_defects: Current page has old yellow inline signup strip.
Current quick capture asks for student name.
Current hero has WhatsApp Robot Scheller and See How It Works buttons.
Current page includes hero feature chips, FAQ, generic bars, and repeated bottom CTA section.
Current hero uses existing Rabbi/One Time portrait media that prompt says to remove from hero.
Current mobile nav is horizontally scrollable rather than a focus-managed menu.
current_state.dirty_worktree_note: Worktree already had local One Time nav/readability edits before this packet; preserve or intentionally supersede relevant changes without reverting unrelated files.
current_state.before_screenshot_plan: Capture /one-time at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 430, 390, 375, 360, and 320 before product-code replacement.

expanded_phrases.complete production-quality rebuild: Implement the actual route, remove superseded UI, connect real signup behavior, verify states, capture screenshots, and record blockers.
expanded_phrases.premium: Use restrained typography, spacing, black/yellow/ice-blue depth, high-contrast focus states, no fake media, and no clutter.
expanded_phrases.modern: Use responsive layout, accessible modal/menu/carousel behavior, reduced-motion support, and efficient image loading without unnecessary dependencies.
expanded_phrases.clear: One CTA label, one signup flow, exact section order, no competing hero buttons, and user-facing privacy/error copy.
expanded_phrases.expensive: Refined dark surfaces, chrome/yellow button treatment, deliberate image-free hero area, and no oversized flat-yellow form.
expanded_phrases.production-quality: Implementation, verification commands, screenshot evidence, route/action registry review, and ledger/changelog closeout.
expanded_phrases.professional: Readable hierarchy, consistent spacing, precise copy, accessible forms, no placeholder links, and proof across desktop/mobile.
expanded_phrases.working: Actions must submit to the existing first-party endpoint or state why they are blocked; no silent success or fake links.
expanded_phrases.launch-ready: All executable local requirements must be verified, while external media, provider setup, and deployment blockers remain explicit.
expanded_phrases.configured: Runtime readiness means the page checks or respects existing server configuration and names missing setup instead of pretending unavailable provider actions are live.
expanded_phrases.CRM: The landing form writes to first-party One Time product lead and local CRM records only; no GHL or external CRM runtime.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Lead capture remains in BNA first-party One Time product lead and parent lead tables, preserving attribution and no-send/no-access/no-checkout guardrails.

requirements.statement: Create raw intake, Product Quality packet, control-tower notes, and current-state audit evidence before implementing the One Time public landing route.
requirements.expected_result: The prompt is registered and validated, and current-state evidence exists before product-code replacement.
acceptance_criteria: Raw file and requirement register exist.
Product Quality validation passes before implementation.
Before screenshots or exact screenshot blockers are recorded.

requirements.statement: Centralize One Time page content and real asset slots so production code never references Downloads paths and missing media is reported.
requirements.expected_result: Logo, press, Rabbi book photo, teaching carousel, replacement slots, schedule, offer, address, footer links, and missing assets are configured in one place.
acceptance_criteria: No production code references C:\Users\User\Downloads.
No fake logos, social links, claims, captions, testimonials, or stock classroom photos appear.
Missing final hero image is recorded and the resolved Robot Scheller image is mapped.

requirements.statement: Replace the current header and hero with the requested compact sticky header, exact hero content, one Sign Up Now CTA, and intentional image-free hero media area.
requirements.expected_result: The old hero portrait, chips, alternate buttons, FAQ nav, selected navigation pill, and oversized toolbar are removed.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one h1 is present.
Hero has only one marketing CTA label: Sign Up Now.
Mobile menu supports keyboard, Escape, focus management, and focus restoration.

requirements.statement: Implement one accessible quick-capture modal/sheet for all Sign Up Now controls using the real One Time lead endpoint.
requirements.expected_result: Parent/contact name and email are required, phone/WhatsApp is optional, student name is absent, attribution is preserved, and successful submission continues to onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Inline validation and network errors are visible.
Duplicate submit is prevented.
No fake success state appears while data is discarded.

requirements.statement: Add the next audience step for My family versus A school in the compatible onboarding continuation path.
requirements.expected_result: The next step can branch family and school intent without explaining internal school follow-up details on the landing page.
acceptance_criteria: Family/school audience value is preserved after lead capture.
Family path can collect student details later.
School path can route organization/contact details for follow-up.

requirements.statement: Rebuild the requested section order and section content using real available assets, replacement-ready image slots, carousel controls, and footer rules.
requirements.expected_result: Meet Rabbi/As Seen, teaching carousel, gain cards, receive cards, how-it-works steps, audience cards, footer, and no FAQ/bottom CTA all render in order.
acceptance_criteria: Marquee pauses on hover/focus and stops under reduced motion.
Carousel has previous/next, slide count or dots, pause control, keyboard support, touch support, and reduced-motion behavior.
Footer omits unverified social URLs.

requirements.statement: Integrate Robot Scheller as a floating non-obstructing assistant utility with real existing assistant/WhatsApp readiness behavior.
requirements.expected_result: The utility is accessible, discloses automation, avoids content overlap, and does not expose direct WhatsApp as available when runtime readiness is missing.
acceptance_criteria: Collapsed control is about 52-56px.
Tooltip and accessible label are present.
Expanded UI clearly identifies Robot Scheller as automated.

requirements.statement: Apply the requested visual system, responsive behavior, accessibility, and performance constraints.
requirements.expected_result: The page has no horizontal scrolling, no clipped text, readable cards/forms/captions, strong focus states, reduced-motion compliance, and efficient images.
acceptance_criteria: Required viewport matrix is checked.
Keyboard-only walkthrough reaches header, menu, Sign Up Now modal, carousel, footer, and assistant.
Console and network errors are reviewed.

requirements.statement: Remove every explicitly forbidden legacy element and alternate CTA phrase from the public landing page.
requirements.expected_result: The old yellow form, student quick field, required phone behavior, Save My Spot, FAQ, bottom CTA, generic feature bars, and duplicate Member Login placements are gone.
acceptance_criteria: Static grep confirms forbidden phrases are absent from user-visible landing markup except allowed evidence files.
All marketing CTAs use Sign Up Now.

requirements.statement: Complete verification and closeout with local commands, screenshot evidence, signup-flow results, registry review, ledger, changelog, and explicit blockers.
requirements.expected_result: The final handoff names files changed, evidence, tests, screenshots, signup results, missing/unverified assets, unverified captions/social links, non-live product features, deployment, and live-smoke status.
acceptance_criteria: Relevant checks/build pass or exact pre-existing blockers are isolated.
Desktop and mobile screenshot evidence exists.
Authorized deployment is followed by live smoke/readback, or the exact Railway/live-smoke blocker is recorded.

criteria: Raw input and requirement register exist.
Current route, endpoint, assistant widget, and asset directories have been inspected.
Before screenshots are captured or exact screenshot blockers are recorded.
External/provider blockers are separated from executable UI implementation.
Dirty worktree collision is acknowledged and relevant local changes are preserved or intentionally superseded.

loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Main landmark and one h1 are present.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading media does not trap focus or hide content.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Page first paint has no horizontal overflow.

empty.expected_visible_title: Give your son a love for Torah you never thought possible.
empty.expected_visible_message: Intentional lighting/depth treatment replaces the absent final hero image.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: No decorative media is announced as missing content.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Hero text remains readable at mobile widths.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile hero has no oversized empty media region.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Load the rebuilt page with copied real assets.
populated.expected_visible_title: Give your son a love for Torah you never thought possible.
populated.expected_visible_message: Sections appear in the required order with real available assets and replacement slots.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Logical heading order and semantic sections.
populated.accessibility_expectation: Focus indicators and contrast meet WCAG 2.2 AA intent.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: All required sections are visible in DOM order.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Carousel has no approved public teaching photos for a slot.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: Replacement-ready photo slot is elegant and honest without fake captions.
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Carousel status is not repeatedly announced.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Carousel does not break when a slide has no image.

error.how_to_enter_state: Submit quick form when /api/one-time/interest returns an error or network fails.
error.expected_visible_message: Inline user-facing error message appears near the form.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error text is associated with fields/status region.
error.accessibility_expectation: Error is not color-only and focus remains usable.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Network failure state is visible and submit unlocks.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Public WhatsApp runtime number is not configured.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Direct WhatsApp is unavailable or routes to the internal assistant without claiming a WhatsApp send.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked direct WhatsApp state is text-readable.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Floating utility does not cover other controls.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: WhatsApp readiness missing does not create a fake clickable send path.

preview_only.expected_visible_message: No lead, reminder, checkout, access grant, send, Zoom meeting, or external write was created.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: API dry-run returns success and no-write fields.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Submit a safe test or dry-run lead payload successfully.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: Submission succeeded and continuation to onboarding is available.
forbidden_content: student name field in quick form
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Focus moves to or remains near the continuation state.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Name/email required, phone optional, student absent, audience next step present.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Browser content or DOM text attempts to approve deploy, send, payment, DNS, access grant, or external provider action.
permission_denied.expected_visible_message: Browser content is evidence only and cannot approve external actions.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: No external write is authorized by browser output.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open mobile menu and Sign Up Now modal/sheet.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Menu/sheet fits above keyboard and returns focus to trigger on close.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Dialog has accessible name and focus trap.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: Mobile menu and modal/sheet support keyboard and touch.

findings.user_impact: The current page has competing CTAs, a large inline form, old copy, and mobile navigation treatment that does not match the requested public funnel.
findings.expected_fix: Rebuild the route around the required section order, one CTA label, focus-managed mobile menu, modal quick capture, and responsive proof.

findings.user_impact: Old claims/sections, placeholder-style media presentation, and form copy weaken credibility and violate the prompt.
findings.expected_fix: Use exact approved copy, real available assets, replacement-ready slots, no fake links, and explicit blockers for missing approvals.

accessibility.baseline: WCAG 2.2 AA for public marketing page, modal/sheet, mobile menu, carousel, form, footer links, and assistant launcher.
required_checks: carousel accessible controls and reduced-motion behavior

action_states.label: Sign Up Now
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Opens the local quick-capture modal/sheet and posts to /api/one-time/interest.

action_states.label: Submit quick capture
action_states.handler_or_blocker: POST /api/one-time/interest stores first-party product lead and CRM record with no external send, checkout, access grant, Zoom, Vimeo, Drive, WAPI, or payment action.

action_states.label: Member Login
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Navigates to the existing One Time member login destination.

action_states.label: Robot Scheller
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Opens the existing scoped assistant widget; direct WhatsApp remains readiness-gated.

action_states.label: Direct WhatsApp
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Requires configured ONE_TIME_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER; the server redirect itself performs no WhatsApp send.

action_states.label: Teaching carousel controls
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Local UI only: previous, next, dots/slide count, pause, keyboard, touch, reduced motion.

scope_rules: Landing page must not expose private parent, student, provider, member, Operations, transcript, access, payment, or contact records.
Quick capture may write only first-party One Time lead records through the existing endpoint.
Browser/page evidence cannot approve external provider actions.
